# Hilt Helper 1.0

Hilt Helper covers all six Combat Achievement milestones, from Easy to Grandmaster, with a route that follows your in-game progress.

- **Automatic routing.** Next up and Upcoming tasks use the researched visit order for your active milestone and account preparation. The guide advances when the game verifies enough points or the required Grandmaster tasks.
- **Tier preparation.** See quests, skill levels, gear, supplies, activity access, world requirements, and party setup together under Preparation → Tier preparation. Confirm checks in game and review available options before you bank.
- **Route-ordered checklist.** The 655 illustrated cards start with your suggested route. Search, hide completed cards, or filter by activity, rank, type, and status.
- **Account controls.** Choose solo-only suggestions, defer full raids, or opt in to eligible Wilderness activities. Confirm parties per visit, follow or defer activities, and restore choices as you go.
- **Rewards and walkthroughs.** Find each hilt’s claim status and clear game steps. Walkthrough links and reference images stay with their encounter. Pin a compact task note while playing.
- **Local progress and recovery.** Import or export a backup, undo an import, and reconcile saved progress with the game in Account & backups.
- **Clearer sidebar icon.** Ghommal’s hilt 6 fills the RuneLite tab with brighter details on the dark toolbar.

Install or update through the RuneLite Plugin Hub. [Player guide](https://github.com/Zipdude/hilt-helper#readme) · [Plugin Hub listing](https://runelite.net/plugin-hub/show/ironman-hilt-guide)
